basic_profile.bio: Greetings! I'm a 31-year-old gaming enthusiast and whiskey aficionado from Austin, Texas. During weekdays, I work as a software developer, but in my free time, you can find me raiding gyms in Pokémon Go, reminiscing about my adventures in Tibia, or experimenting with new whiskey flavors. I'm also an active participant in the LGBTQ+ gaming community, often exploring new subreddits related to my interests. I tend to be online during the evenings, usually after 7 PM CST, and on weekends. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to explore my hobbies and engage with fellow gamers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science which led me to a career in software development. My interest in technology extends beyond work, as I frequently explore gaming and tech subreddits to keep up with the latest trends. My passion for whiskey is self-taught, fueled by community discussions and tastings.
